neutral.EN: Take care.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka.

neutral.EN: Stay safe out there.
neutral.TL: Maging ligtas ka sa labas.

neutral.EN: Watch yourself.
neutral.TL: Ingatan mo sarili mo.

neutral.EN: Until next time.
neutral.TL: Hanggang sa muli.

neutral.EN: Keep your guard up.
neutral.TL: Panatilihing mataas ang depensa.

neutral.EN: Stay sharp on the road.
neutral.TL: Magmatyag sa kalsada.

neutral.EN: Catch you later.
neutral.TL: Mamaya ulit.

neutral.EN: Safe travels.
neutral.TL: Ligtas na paglalakbay.

neutral.EN: Keep breathing out there.
neutral.TL: Manatiling buhay sa labas.

neutral.EN: See you around.
neutral.TL: Magkita na lang tayo.

neutral.EN: Take care. I will see you soon.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka. Magkikita tayo sa lalong madaling panahon.

neutral.EN: Stay safe, my friend. Come back in one piece.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka, kaibigan. Bumalik kang buo.

neutral.EN: Look after yourself. Don't be a stranger.
neutral.TL: Alagaan mo sarili mo. Huwag kang mawawala.

neutral.EN: Good luck out there. See you soon.
neutral.TL: Magandang kapalaran sa labas. Hanggang sa muli.

neutral.EN: Keep your head down and stay safe. Talk soon.
neutral.TL: Yumuko sa panganib at mag-ingat. Usap tayo ulit.

neutral.EN: It was good seeing you. Safe travels.
neutral.TL: Mabuti at nagkita tayo. Ligtas na paglalakbay.

neutral.EN: Take care of yourself. I'll be waiting.
neutral.TL: Alagaan mo sarili mo. Hihintayin kita.

neutral.EN: Watch your back out there, friend.
neutral.TL: Bantayan ang likod mo sa labas, kaibigan.

neutral.EN: Stay alive. We'll share a drink next time.
neutral.TL: Manatiling buhay. Mag-inuman tayo sa susunod.

neutral.EN: Be careful out there. See you shortly.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka sa labas. Magkikita tayo sa lalong madaling panahon.
